label: Lyndon
header:
# Lyndon municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 13; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Lyndon's five selectboard members as Daniel Daley, Kevin Horner, Christopher Hunter, Susan Mills, and Christian Thompson
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 126 (Town of Lyndon): sections 22 and 26: five Selectboard members are elected to three-year terms

Town of Lyndon, 2025 Town Report: 'Town Officers 2025' table seats Kermit Fisher in the seat expiring 2026 where the June 2026 SOS directory seats Kevin Horner; the directory set (Dan Daley III, Kevin Horner, Christopher Hunter, Susan Mills, Christian Thompson) is the current board
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 126 (Town of Lyndon): section 22: a Town Clerk is elected to a three-year term
Town of Lyndon, 2025 Town Report: 'Town Officers 2025' table: Dawn R. Dwyer is Clerk and Treasurer (term to 2027)
Town of Lyndon (official website), Town Clerk page: Dawn Dwyer is Town Clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Dawn Dwyer as Lyndon's town clerk

24 App. V.S.A. ch. 126 (Town of Lyndon): section 22: a Town Treasurer is elected to a three-year term as a separate office from the Clerk; the town report lists a combined 'Clerk and Treasurer' line, and the two posts carry one holder
Town of Lyndon, 2025 Town Report: 'Town Officers 2025' table: Dawn R. Dwyer is Clerk and Treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Dawn Dwyer as Lyndon's treasurer

24 App. V.S.A. ch. 126 (Town of Lyndon): section 22: a Moderator is elected to a one-year term. The 2025 town report seats Dan Daley III with a term expiring in 2026 and no official source publishes the 2026 outcome, so the post is created without a membership
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 126 (Town of Lyndon): section 22: Listers are elected to three-year terms, their number (three, four, or five) determined by the Selectboard; Lyndon carries three

Town of Lyndon, 2025 Town Report: 'Town Officers 2025' table: Listers Carol Fisher (term to 2027) and Linda Lee (2028); Lawrence Willey's term expired in 2026 with no published outcome, so his seat is unfilled
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 126 (Town of Lyndon): section 22: five Cobleigh Library Trustees are elected to five-year terms

Town of Lyndon, 2025 Town Report: 'Town Officers 2025' table: Sylvia Dodge (term to 2027), Jessica Drew Simpson (2028), Mary Thomas (2029), and Bruce Starbuck (2030); Paula Pearce's term expired in 2026 with no published outcome, so her seat is unfilled

offices.title: Trustee of the Sanborn School Fund

sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 126 (Town of Lyndon): section 22: three Trustees of the Sanborn School Fund are elected to three-year terms

Town of Lyndon, 2025 Town Report: 'Town Officers 2025' table: Kelly Harris (term to 2027) and David Stahler Sr. (2028); Eric Paris's term expired in 2026 with no published outcome, so his seat is unfilled
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 126 (Town of Lyndon): section 22: a Town Agent is elected to a one-year term; the town officers table lists no holder, so the post is created without a membership
Town of Lyndon, 2025 Town Report: 'Appointed by the Selectboard' page: 'Delinquent Tax Collector: Treasurer, Dawn Dwyer'

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): names fifteen justices of the peace for Lyndon: Jeremiah Aiken, Catherine Boykin, Kevin Calkins, Dan Daley, Elizabeth Dronkert, Libre Drouin, Reed Garfield, Robert Gerrish, Bruce James, Sue Mason, Sean McFeeley, Brenda Mitchell, Beth Quimby, Susan Russell, and Kelsey Stetson

Town of Lyndon, 2025 Town Report: 'Town Officers 2025' table's JP block names Ashley Gerrish where the certified listing names Brenda Mitchell, and prints 'Sue Russell' for Susan Russell; the certified listing governs
